component: Thunderbird Windows sandbox child startup bridge

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The owned Windows MOZ_SANDBOX branch includes TargetGeckoServices.h and supplies SetTargetGeckoServices through childData.setTargetGeckoServices before XRE_InitChildProcess. It replaces the old logging callback member, so the change has an actual service-interface role. The previously documented target-service/XPCOM ordering is reused separately. Fixed comm source retains the new member/header, but the paired Gecko interface and implementation were not inspected; no ABI, sandbox or build result is established.
title: The Windows sandbox repair changes the child service callback and its header
